description: This file defines extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically related to the Conduit project. It includes methods to set up mediation, validation, JWT authentication, and logging.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to configure services for the Conduit application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures core services such as MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and dependency injection for various interfaces.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT authentication, including token validation parameters and event handling for token extraction from headers.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console output and attaches it to the provided ILoggerFactory.
